ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json var formData = payload.parts --- { inputData: formData.inputExample.content as String, expectedOutput: formData.outputExample.content as String, contextInstructions: formData.instructions.content as String default "", generationMode: formData.generationMode.content as String default "balanced", excelFilename: formData.excelFilename.content as String default "", targetDirectory: formData.targetDirectory.content as String default "", boomiMappingFile: if (formData.boomiMapping?) formData.boomiMapping else null, timestamp: now() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var mode = vars.requestData.generationMode var modeConfigs = { fast: { provider: "gemini", model: "gemini-2.5-flash", fallbackModel: "gemini-2.5-flash", temperature: 0.3, maxTokens: 8000, timeout: 90000 }, pro: { provider: "gemini", model: "gemini-2.5-pro", fallbackModel: "gemini-2.5-flash", temperature: 0.1, maxTokens: 32000, timeout: 300000 } } --- modeConfigs[mode] default modeConfigs.fast

%dw 2.0 output text/plain var basePrompt = vars.promptTemplate default "Generate comprehensive mapping documentation" var inputData = vars.requestData.inputData var outputData = vars.requestData.expectedOutput var instructions = vars.requestData.contextInstructions default "" var mode = vars.requestData.generationMode var boomiData = vars.boomiData --- basePrompt replace "{{INPUT_DATA}}" with inputData replace "{{OUTPUT_DATA}}" with outputData replace "{{CONTEXT_INSTRUCTIONS}}" with instructions replace "{{GENERATION_MODE}}" with mode replace "{{TIMESTAMP}}" with (now() as String) replace "{{#if BOOMI_MAPPING_DATA}}" with (if (boomiData != null) "" else "<!--") replace "{{BOOMI_MAPPING_DATA}}" with (write(boomiData, "application/json") default "null") replace "{{/if}}" with (if (boomiData != null) "" else "-->")

%dw 2.0 output application/java var fileName = if ( !isEmpty(vars.requestData.excelFilename) ) if ( lower(vars.requestData.excelFilename) endsWith ".xlsx" ) vars.requestData.excelFilename else (vars.requestData.excelFilename ++ ".xlsx") else "/Mapping_Sheet_$(now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}).xlsx" var folderPath = if ( !isEmpty(vars.requestData.targetDirectory) ) vars.requestData.targetDirectory else p('file.output.defaultDirectory') --- (folderPath ++ "/" ++ fileName) replace "//" with "/"

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, message: "Mapping sheet generated successfully", filename: (vars.writeFilePath splitBy "/")[-1] , filePath: vars.writeFilePath, generationMode: vars.requestData.generationMode, boomiIntegrated: vars.boomiData != null, metadata: { timestamp: vars.requestData.timestamp, generationTime: (now() - vars.requestData.timestamp) as String, version: "1.0.0" }, summary: vars.mappingData.summary.recommendedApproach default "Mapping sheet generated with comprehensive field mappings and business rules." }
